environment.java:
openjdk version "23.0.2" 2025-01-21
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-23.0.2+7 (build 23.0.2+7)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-23.0.2+7 (build 23.0.2+7, mixed mode, sharing)

design.warmupScope: OS/file caches only; every scenario still starts a fresh JVM, with no shared JIT warmup.
design.ordering: Alternate cloud-first and edge-first by repetition and camera-count index.
design.profilePolicy: One fixed profile ID/trace per camera count across measured repetitions; identical profile for each pair.

measurementNotes.loopLatencyMs: Legacy key: raw TimeKeeper clock average; report as simulator time units, not milliseconds.
measurementNotes.analyticsLatencyMs: Legacy key: emission-to-Event_Detector arrival clock average; excludes Event_Detector computation and final delivery.
measurementNotes.processedTuples: Result tuple arrivals at the cloud-storage module, not decoded frames or confirmed storage-computation completions.
measurementNotes.wallClockMillis: Java measurement from controller setup through metrics collection, excluding build, JVM startup and topology construction.
measurementNotes.driverWallClockMillis: External Java subprocess elapsed wall-clock, including JVM startup; excludes build.
measurementNotes.inference: No Python video analysis or YOLO/ByteTrack inference is run by these experiments.
